findings.issue: יקדש is qal imperfect 3ms (be/become holy). “se santificará” is causative santificar plus reflexive se, shifting the stem toward making oneself holy or being made holy.
בהם is suffix 3rd masculine plural. “ellas” is feminine plural, matching Spanish ofrendas rather than the Hebrew masculine plural.
Qal imperfect 3ms is rendered with future subjunctive tocare; person and number hold, and the mood is Spanish smoothing.
מ is source/partitive “from” the fire-offerings. “desde” can be read as a temporal starting point.

notes: Person, number, Jehová, Aarón, and the 3fs object la match the tokens; the qal of יקדש does not.
